name: Decorative Randomiser
features: Random rotation for newly placed decorative items
Three-state colour control: off, full wheel, or Colour Focused inside a circular area around the picker position
Three-state brightness control: off, 40-100%, or Brightness Focused within 15 percentage points of the picker value
Live focused colour and brightness updates from picker changes
Native-style Items menu controls and tooltips
Drag Demolition from the Items menu
Demolish Museum from the Items menu
